headline: 🎉 225 WILLOW POINT RETURNED THE FIRST FEEDBACK OF ITS LIFE AT 9:47 THIS MORNING — twenty minutes after a plain email asked for it, on a listing whose showing system has never once sent a request. The buyers “really liked it,” every concern is cosmetic, and the price went unchallenged when asked about directly. ⚠️ UNDERNEATH THAT, THE MONEY IS STILL THE PROBLEM: a commission you already earned is administratively frozen at the brokerage on day four, a debt-settlement draft is scheduled for tomorrow against a balance that cannot cover it, and the task list that would normally carry all of this is disconnected from the fleet. · DO: unblock 5167 Lake Crest — two calls, day 4 · WATCH: 195 Lake View — three closing items, four days to the table.

notes: 🔌 THE TASK LIST IS DISCONNECTED FROM THE FLEET — SEVEN ROUTINES HIT THE IDENTICAL WALL THIS MORNING and not one could write you a single task: the morning letter, the marketing run, the lead sweeps, the inbox triage, the money pulse, the pipeline forecast and the Monday review. ⚠️ CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS PAGE, STATED PLAINLY: today's call block below is NOT read from your task list — it is rebuilt from this morning's verified letters and sweeps. The open-row count further down is Saturday's last good read, not today's.

🔴 EIGHTEEN AND A HALF HOURS DARK — Sunday 1:5x PM to Monday 8:24 AM, the fourth outage in about ten days. ⭐ FOUR ROUTINES CAUGHT THEMSELVES UP ON REOPEN and are deliberately not being re-run, since that would have doubled their work: the lead briefing, marketing, the opportunity board and two lead sweeps. 🔍 NOT RECOVERED, and named so nobody assumes they ran: Sunday evening's lead briefing, Sunday night's deep dive, and this morning's money, finance and trading passes all fired late or not at all.

✅ THE SHOWING FEED SETTLED TWO OPEN QUESTIONS, BOTH IN THE GOOD DIRECTION. All three houses on yesterday's buyer tour were HELD — all three listing offices sent feedback requests within ninety minutes, which no office does for a tour that did not happen — so you owe three replies. 🎉 AND 225 WILLOW POINT RETURNED THE FIRST FEEDBACK OF ITS LIFE at 9:47 this morning, twenty minutes after a plain email asked for it, with the price unchallenged. 🔍 THAT SECOND ONE ALSO CORRECTED THIS BOARD: the two Saturday showings were one buyer party covering for each other, not two brokerages, and this page said otherwise for two days.

callBlock.who: Jeremy P. — the closing attorney on 5167 Lake Crest
callBlock.why: 🔴 THE ONE THING, AND IT IS DAY FOUR. You sat at that table Thursday; the brokerage's own file now reads EXPIRED with proof of payment still listed as REQUIRED, and not one of its three exits has been taken. ⭐ TWO CALLS, IN ORDER: ask his office whether it funded and recorded and to send the settlement statement — that document is the proof — then call brokerage support to reopen the file. ⚠️ No phone number for him exists on any surface the fleet can read; the email address is the only handle, so this may have to start in writing.

callBlock.who: Don and Ann C. — 198 Rena, plus Joyce C. at the closing office
callBlock.why: 🎉 IT CAME TOGETHER SUNDAY EVENING AND NOTHING ON THIS BOARD KNEW IT UNTIL THIS MORNING — terms agreed, concessions agreed, both sides at two and a half. ⚠️ THE CONTRACT WAS OPENED FOR SIGNATURE AT 8:06 THIS MORNING AND IS STILL UNSIGNED. ⭐ A handshake on Sunday and an unsigned document on Monday is the most fragile state a deal ever occupies; the whole call is get it signed today. 🔍 Your coordinator also promised the seller a call back Friday afternoon that has not happened.

callBlock.who: Angela S. at the title firm — 195 Lake View
callBlock.why: 🔴 SHE LISTED THREE MISSING ITEMS ON 8/20 AND NOBODY HAS ANSWERED HER IN FOUR DAYS: survey, home warranty, septic and sewer inspection. ⭐ SEPTIC IS THE ONE WITH LEAD TIME — a problem found on the 27th does not close on the 28th, and the table is Friday at 4:00. 🔍 The date itself is settled: the title firm put Friday the 28th in writing and that outranks the 8/31 the brokerage system still prints. 🎯 There is also a wire-versus-check question open on this file — settle it by voice on this same call, never by email.

callBlock.who: Robert B. — the buyer's agent on 1709 Fieldstone
callBlock.why: ⚠️ THEY MOVED ON A SATURDAY AND HAVE HEARD NOTHING SINCE. The roof scope came back and any licensed roofer is acceptable — that is the good version of the answer, and it is still sitting in a draft. ⭐ A TEXT SATURDAY AFTERNOON PUNTED ESCROW TO TODAY, AND THE ESCROW ANSWER PRICES THE SCOPE ANSWER — how the holdback gets sized depends on it, so take that half first. 🔍 Matching their weekend pace is the cheapest way to keep this on the inspection step instead of past it.

callBlock.who: Nine new leads — five emailed at 8:4x, zero called
callBlock.why: 🔍 THE HONEST GAP IS NOT THE EMAIL, IT IS THE PHONE. Five got a first touch within minutes of the fleet waking up; the number called is still zero. ⚠️ TWO OF THEM CANNOT BE EMAILED AT ALL — their addresses hard-bounce, so for those two the phone is not the better channel, it is the only one. ⭐ One more was correctly left alone: the ownership check proved she belongs to a teammate, which is the guard working exactly as designed.

callBlock.who: Anna C. — she answered on Willow Point, and asked you three things
callBlock.why: 🎉 YOUR EMAIL AT 9:27 PRODUCED THE FIRST FEEDBACK THIS LISTING HAS EVER RETURNED, TWENTY MINUTES LATER — after this board spent two days saying no form was coming. ⭐ THE PRICE WAS ASKED ABOUT DIRECTLY AND SHE DID NOT ARGUE IT: buyers “really liked it,” house “showed very well,” concerns all cosmetic. 🔍 SHE ALSO CORRECTED THE RECORD — she was covering for Lindsey H., so Saturday's two showings were ONE buyer party, not two brokerages. 🎯 She asked three things and two need your sellers first: the living-room ceiling crack, whether crown molding returns or gets cut in with paint, and the laundry-room access panel. ⚠️ Friday's agent was asked at the same time and has not replied.

callBlock.who: Daniel B. — Deer Ridge Lakes, and Zach the builder
callBlock.why: 🏗️ TWO PEOPLE ARE WAITING AND BOTH ANSWERS ALREADY EXIST. The builder who called off your yard sign is now six days without a callback, and a builder does not buy one lot, he buys a phase. ⚠️ The furthest-along buyer is on day twelve waiting for the perc answer — which your teammate found on Friday and which is still sitting on a board instead of in his ear. 🔍 That is a delegation gap, not a research gap. 📅 The build-and-sell versus vacant-lots thinking you promised the seller was due today.

callBlock.who: Carlos B. — asked you what his property is worth
callBlock.why: 🆕 HE ASKED YOU POINT-BLANK, HE OWNS THE PROPERTY, AND HE HAS NOW COME BACK A SECOND TIME INSIDE THIRTY-ONE HOURS. ⚠️ THE REPLY HAS BEEN DRAFTED AND UNSENT FOR ROUGHLY TWO DAYS. ⭐ A contact-form question is somebody typing your name on purpose, not clicking an ad — and your site fires no instant alert on those at all, so this one only exists because a sweep re-queried the inbox. 🔍 A second homeowner surfaced overnight on a different address asking the same question.

listings.status: ⏰ CLOSED AT THE TABLE — and administratively frozen, day 4

This is the highest-leverage call you own today.

listings.note: ⚠️ THE BUYERS MOVED ON A SATURDAY AND THE ANSWER IS STILL A DRAFT. She filed it herself — interested YES, her buyers just started looking, really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list — and she phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so a call back is returned, not cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED RIGHT BLANK: the objection is unasked, not absent. ⚠️ Nine days is past the window where a machine outreach is appropriate, so this is a human call now. 🔴 The basement lights she reported still have no answer, and he is the only man alive who knows why.

A live post from 8/20 still says the old number out loud, the publishing tool cannot delete it, and the corrected post could not go out this morning because its scheduled slot had already passed by the time the fleet woke up — it is now re-armed for tomorrow at 7:30. ⭐ THE OBJECTION ON THIS HOUSE IS SQUARE FOOTAGE, NOT THE NUMBER, on both of the passes it took — so another cut buys nothing. 🔍 Its showings have now aged out of the two-week window entirely, which is its own kind of signal.

All three gates are essentially behind it. ⚠️ TWO QUIET ITEMS, BOTH PAPERWORK RATHER THAN CONDITION, AND BOTH NOW OVER A WEEK OLD: the inspection requests have sat with your seller since 8/17, and the title firm still cannot find your seller's name in title, with a third name in play on the same file. ⭐ Neither fixes itself, and a title-vesting problem found in September on a September closing is exactly the kind that moves a date.

🔴 FIVE MONTHS, AND A CLIENT WHO STILL OPENS THE CONVERSATION HIMSELF. He texted with a couple of questions Saturday morning and has now waited two days. ⭐ A MAN WHO HAS WATCHED FIVE MONTHS PASS AND STILL REACHES OUT FIRST IS NOT ANGRY YET — that is the window, and it closes by the hour rather than the week. 🔍 The straight-conversation email is drafted and waiting on your send; day 157 has earned the honest version, not another update.

🔴 THE MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING IN THE BOOK AND NOT ONE TOUR HAS EVER BEEN BOOKED ON IT. ⭐ THE WEEKEND SHARPENED THE POINT RATHER THAN SOFTENING IT: a $185,000 listing pulled three tours in twenty-one hours off the same marketing machine that has never produced a single booking here. 🔍 The comp work says the big-house ceiling in that zip is roughly $950K unless acreage carries it — which makes the silence a pricing answer, not a marketing one. The day-32 conversation is drafted and waiting.

isa.sweepCadence: every 30 minutes while the fleet is up — but it was NOT up: an eighteen-and-a-half-hour hole runs from Sunday afternoon to 8:24 this morning, the fourth outage in about ten days. ✅ THE RECOVERY WAS THE BEST SINGLE PIECE OF WORK TODAY: the first sweep back sent seven first touches in one pass and later passes carried it past twenty, and every one of them was found by querying the inbox by sender — because the instant-lead webhook, the lane that is supposed to catch them, returned empty on all of them. ⭐ THAT IS THE FINDING THAT MATTERS: the alerting artery kept firing all weekend while the working artery was stopped, so alerts alone never proved the machine was running. 🔍 The ownership guard held through all of it and correctly left a teammate's lead untouched. ⚠️ About one in eight of today's first touches hard-bounced — those are phone-only from here.
